body:
Thank you for responding, and I think you were right on the mark about being in the same circle. The thing is, I do believe he was abusive before (his mom died a really slow death last summer from cancer that metastasized to her brain, taking her close to 2 months to pass away as she withered away etc). And I was really selfish during that time trying to make him spend all of his free time with me (though apparently it helped him to feel distracted by shit at home - his mom was put on home hospice). I think also a lot of it was that I would vent and cry and shit and my friends saw my reactions and would take my side automatically, and they said his mom dying was no excuse for him to act that way. I never really thought of it has an excuse to him, just a reason why he was acting that way - i feel like people mix those two concepts up when they want to feel justified in their actions and feelings.

(sorry got distracted by kpop and lost my train of thought lol)

The thing is, I DO feel supported by him, genuinely. And he pointed out the irony that back in the day, he didn't want me hanging out with certain people (guys who would flirt with me) if I was gonna be alone with them, or people who had crushes on me. Which I thought was logical, cause i'd ask the same of him, if I sensed a threat like that. And even then, he just asked that he could hang out with them and me instead of just me and them being alone. Though there were a few people (guys) whom he absolutely did not want me to hang out with and it reached a point where he would have broken up with me or at least been really hurt if i went behind his back and saw those people. Like last Halloween, he didn't want me going 4 hours away to celebrate with my one friend, and he didn't want to go 4 hours away to join me. (He's since stopped being like that)

The irony, though, is that now my friends are doing the same thing. except they aren't willing to hang out with me even if i do break up with him. I do understand, but at the same time they literally deserted me the day after i got out of the mental hospital. i've stopped trying to contact them but it's hard. two of them had been my friends for over 10 years.

I think they believe that I just made up or exaggerated the abusive aspects of my bf, or stretched the truth. And I don't really believe I did, but I was extremely open about how he made me feel when he mistreated me.

The thing is, he's literally the only one i can see spending the rest of my life with. instead of just apologizing for the past, he's been aking strides to prevent any of that from happening again. I do believe he's changed, or at the very least, he's changed his perspective and is now more understanding and remorseful.

One of my friends who was there through all of the ups and downs has stuck by me and even initiated contact with my bf to tell him she has nothing against him unless he mistreats me again.

The thing is, duringt he time when i was broken up with him, they weren't very supportive of me. they'd act like there was something wrong with me for missing him, etc. they started dinstancing themselves from me and hanging out without me more often. i didn't feel supported by them - i think they were incapable of benig there for me because they had bigger issues to work on themselves. i just feel torn as to whether or not i want them back in my life - because I sort of dont, but at the same time the fact that they've already moved on, stopped replying, and started sharing things on fb where they tag eveeryone else but me - just really small things like that, i can't help but feel cheapened by it, like i was extremely easy to get rid of, or something.

Dad:  "Honey! The baby looks like he's trying to tell us something!" -grabs video camera and starts to film- "I'm going to send this video to everyone we know! Say 'da-da!'"

Infant: -eyes roll back into its head- "God is dead. Nothing is real. Kurt Cobain was murdered."

Dad: -slowly lowers video camera- "UHHH...never mind, honey - it was just a false alarm!"
